::: {.themes-section}
## Research Themes

::: {.themes-grid}
::: {.theme}
<span class="theme-index">I</span>

### Energy &amp; Power Sector Reform

Power purchase agreements, smart meters, electricity theft, and solar diffusion — with evidence from Pakistan, Ethiopia, Ghana, and Myanmar.
:::

::: {.theme}
<span class="theme-index">II</span>

### AI &amp; the Ladder of Development

How artificial intelligence reshapes structural transformation and the path to prosperity for low- and middle-income economies.
:::

::: {.theme}
<span class="theme-index">III</span>

### Climate Change &amp; Human Capital

Mobility, migration, and the unequal effects of a changing climate — and how education shapes who can adapt.
:::

::: {.theme}
<span class="theme-index">IV</span>

### Public Finance

Customs evasion, tariff design, and subsidy reform, with a focus on Pakistan's fiscal and energy crises.
:::
:::
:::

::: {.selected-band}
::: {.band-inner}
## Selected Work

<ul class="selected-list">
<li>
<a class="work-title" href="research.qmd">AI and the Ladder of Development</a>

</li>

<a class="work-title" href="research.qmd">The Economic Costs of Lopsided Contracts</a>
<span class="work-note">Evidence from power purchase agreements in Pakistan, with F. Hayat &amp; S. Srivastav.</span>
</li>
<li>
<a class="work-title" href="research.qmd">Human Capital, Mobility, and the Unequal Effects of Climate Change</a>
<span class="work-note">How education generates mobility across sectors and locations as a channel for climate adaptation.</span>
</li>
<li>
<a class="work-title" href="research.qmd">Deciphering the Miracle on the Han</a>
<span class="work-note">How South Korea escaped poverty and transformed its economy, with O. Bandiera, R. Burgess &amp; co-authors.</span>

## In the Policy Room

<p>Recent engagements include advising Pakistan's Prime Minister and Ministers of Energy and Finance on tariff and tax reform, and Ethiopia's Ministry of Planning on national energy policy. More on the [Policy](policy.qmd) and [CV](cv.qmd) pages.</p>
